add_minter.description: Add an additional minter. Only the primary minter (manager) can call this.

approve.description:
Allows operator to transfer / send the token from the owner's account.
If expiration is set, then this allowance has a time/height limit

approve_all.description:
Allows operator to transfer / send any token from the owner's account.
If expiration is set, then this allowance has a time/height limit

burn.description: Burn an NFT the sender has access to

mint.description: Mint a new NFT, can only be called by the contract minter

extension.description: Any custom extension used by this contract

owner.description: The owner of the newly minter NFT

token_uri.description:
Universal resource identifier for this NFT
Should point to a JSON file that conforms to the ERC721
Metadata JSON Schema

remove_minter.description: Remove an additional minter. Only the primary minter (manager) can call this.

remove_withdraw_address.description: Removes the withdraw address, so fees are sent to the contract. Only owner can call this.

send_nft.description:
Send is a base message to transfer a token to a contract and trigger an action
on the receiving contract.

set_withdraw_address.description: Sets address to send withdrawn fees to. Only owner can call this.

transfer_nft.description: Transfer is a base message to move a token to another account without triggering actions

update_collection_info.description: The creator is the only one eligible to update `CollectionInfo`.

update_extension.description: Custom msg execution. This is a no-op in default implementation.

update_nft_info.description:
The creator is the only one eligible to update NFT's token uri and onchain metadata (`NftInfo.extension`).
NOTE: approvals and owner are not affected by this call, since they belong to the NFT owner.

token_uri.description: NOTE: Empty string is handled as None

update_ownership.description: Deprecated: use UpdateMinterOwnership instead! Will be removed in next release!

withdraw_funds.description:
Withdraw from the contract to the given address. Anyone can call this,
which is okay since withdraw address has been set by owner.

definitions.name: cw_ownable_Action
definitions.description: Actions that can be taken to alter the contract's ownership

accept_ownership.description:
Accept the pending ownership transfer.

Can only be called by the pending owner.

renounce_ownership.description:
Give up the contract's ownership and the possibility of appointing
a new owner.

Can only be invoked by the contract's current owner.

Any existing pending ownership transfer is canceled.

transfer_ownership.description:
Propose to transfer the contract's ownership to another account,
optionally with an expiry time.

Can only be called by the contract's current owner.

Any existing pending ownership transfer is overwritten.

definitions.name: cw_utils_expiration_Expiration
definitions.description:
Expiration represents a point in time when some event happens.
It can compare with a BlockInfo and will return is_expired() == true
once the condition is hit (and for every block in the future)

never.description: Never will never expire. Used to express the empty variant

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_timestamp_Timestamp

mint_start_time.description: Timestamp of mint start. If less than current block, mints available

price_tiers.description: Price tiers for minting. Empty or None = free mint.

require_auth.description:
When true, every mint must include valid ADR-36 `ext` auth
(`CosmosArbitrary` over DST+nonce[|digest]). Required for trustless
pledge collections; default false preserves open-mint SVG drops.

template_slots.description:
Pre-computed placeholder positions in the SVG template.
Each slot maps a `${varname}` occurrence to its byte offsets and variable index.

whitelist.description: Optional merkle whitelist contract address. Whitelisted minters bypass fees.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

options.description: Pick from a list of string values

range.description:
Generate a decimal string in [min, max] at given precision.
`min` and `max` are decimal strings (e.g. "-2.5", "80").

rgb.description:
Generate a random `rgb(R,G,B)` color string.
Each channel is independently random in 0–255.

rgb_styled.description:
Pick a random range from the list, then generate a random shade within it.
Each channel is constrained to [min, max] of the selected range.

definitions.name: cw721_svg_contract_PriceTier
definitions.description:
A price tier that applies until the mint count reaches `until_count`.
Tiers must be sorted ascending by `until_count`.
Example: [{ until_count: 100, price: 1_000_000utoken }, { until_count: 500, price: 5_000_000utoken }]
means: first 100 mints cost 1 token, mints 101-500 cost 5 tokens.

price.description: Price per token in this tier

until_count.description: This tier applies while mint_count < until_count

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_uint256_Uint256

update_whitelist.description: Owner-only: set or clear the merkle whitelist contract address

address.description: Set to Some(addr) to enable whitelist, None to disable

alloc.description:
Per-address mint allocation encoded in the merkle leaf.
When set, the leaf is hash(sender || allocation) and this value
caps how many tokens the address can mint via whitelist.

amnt.description: amount of tokens to mint. Must send atleast `t` funds, where t >= amnt * mint-fee

ext.description:
Required ADR-36 authentication (`CosmosArbitrary`).

Message bytes must start with {@link crate::CW721SVG_DST} and follow
the v1/v2 formats documented on {@link AUTH_MSG_MAX_EXTRA}.
Signature is one-time: `(message_hex, pubkey_hex)` is consumed in
`MINTER_NONCE` storage so the same auth cannot be replayed.

proof_hashes.description: Merkle proof hashes for whitelist verification (bypasses mint fees)
